definition.text: A cyclic series of interconversions of the one-carbon unit carried by tetrahydrofolate - as 10-formyltetrahydrofolate, 5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolate, 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate and 5-methyltetrahydrofolate. Couples the acquisition of a one-carbon unit from donors such as serine, glycine or formate with its transfer, in the appropriate oxidation state, to biosynthetic acceptors, and with regeneration of tetrahydrofolate.
